“We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say
‘The Son of Man must be lifted up?’ Who is this Son of Man?”
Then the people in answer said to him
The law says that the Christ will have life without end: how say you then that it is necessary for the Son of man to be lifted up? Who is this Son of man?
